ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your dispute is upheld in part. The governing distance field under POL-RD-01 is the trace figure, and EV-GPS-02849 records 18.2 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off against a booked optimal of 14.0 km on EV-TRIP-02849. The excess is 4.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal, so both establishment tests in POL-RD-01 pass (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%) and a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation: 4.2 km is below the 8.0 km limb and 30.0% is below the 50% limb. The driver-profile check therefore decides nothing for you either way, and in any event it shows no repeat pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 201 completed trips in 90 days, so the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift and the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral cannot attach. No rider-requested detour exists (the chat log EV-CHAT-02849 holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 has nothing to run on), no endpoint was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so POL-RD-05 does not run), the vehicle type is RYDE_X and not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12 does not run), and the fare model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null (POL-RD-11 does not run).

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary. recomputed_fare = (base 3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 optimal km = 10.50 + 0.28 x 19.0 optimal min = 5.32) = 19.62, times the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (the only artifact carrying that field), plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, toll, surcharge, waiting-time or promo line = 20.42. charged_total is 26.73. Refund = 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, and the payable figure rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 is 6.35. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and is 23.6% of the charged total, below the 90% that would convert the award to a full refund, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35. That figure exceeds the 5.00 you contested; it is the policy arithmetic on your fare, not a round-number goodwill payment. POL-RD-09 adds nothing and nothing is double-counted: erp_gantries is empty, all three erp_lines totals are 0.00, and there is no airport surcharge (the trip originates at Jurong Point, not an airport).

To the driver: your explanation that 'navigation rerouted me' is a bare assertion with no artifact behind it. The bundle holds no traffic advisory for this trip window - EV-ADVIS-02849-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight. Because no advisory identifier is cited by your side as the basis of an exoneration, POL-RD-13(1) applies: the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle and not the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes, so it does not escalate this case. You were also billed exactly the distance the trace records (18.2 km), so there is no unbilled shortfall and no DRIVER_COMPENSATION under POL-RD-04.

Evidence integrity, stated expressly as POL-GEN-02(3) and POL-RD-07 require: EV-GPS-02849 is IMPAIRED at the schema layer, weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW (a single 40.0 s gap across 0.4 km). It is NOT impaired for POL-RD-07 policy purposes: the gap is under 90 s, the straight-line step is under 500 m, and sampling holds at 10 s, so limbs (a) to (c) are unmet, no independent corroboration of the excess is required, and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. The schema impairment is a confidence discount only: the deciding excess is carried by the trace at 0.85 (the trip record's actual_distance_km is a rounded copy of the same measurement and is not an independent carrier), so confidence is capped at 0.85 and the deviation finding survives the discount.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, so the case is ruled rather than escalated: the trip identifiers match across EV-TRIP-02849, EV-GPS-02849 and EV-FARE-02849; the trace is policy-clean; the timestamps agree and do not run backwards; every fare-breakdown line has a counterpart; and the refund of 6.31 is far below 150.00 and below charged_total. No referral is produced by any clause: POL-RD-06(c) needs an established repeat pattern (there is none) and POL-RD-09(4) needs an unmatched charge (there is none). The monetary effect of 6.35 does not exceed the 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue. Either party may appeal once, within 30 days, under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
